scope: Three isolated customer scenarios using production runtime, physical support checks, ledger and courier. Scans are decoded-label fixture input; explicit fixture placement settles in real PhysX. This does not simulate native mouse controls or rendered guidance.
checks: Receiving opens with exactly two unreceived cartons and no automatic receipt
Reading demonstration guidance does not mutate stock or grant progress
Prepared demonstrations protect their documents and equipment from unrelated manager mutations
A wrong handheld tile recovers with the correct task instruction
Location guidance exposes a real physical label and camera projection
One receipt advances exactly one carton and duplicate confirmation is rejected
Received stock still requires guided physical putaway
Receiving finishes only after both real cartons are received and supported in their assigned storage bins
Receiving and putaway conserve all cartons: Stock, order allocations and bin capacities reconcile.
Transfer starts with one available carton and an uncluttered document list
A different valid transfer does not falsely complete the demo and guidance follows the new recorded source
The corrected transfer records both real moves, completes the guide and preserves stock quantity
Transfers conserve stock after correction: Stock, order allocations and bin capacities reconcile.
Picking opens with one prepared allocation and no free shipment progress
A confirmed physical pick books the actual carrier without shipping or paying
The loaded manifest remains on hand and the demonstration stays incomplete before departure
Closing doors and driving out do not prematurely finish the customer demonstration
Only actual offsite departure completes picking and shipping and posts one customer payment
The completed customer shipment conserves all stock and allocation quantities: Stock, order allocations and bin capacities reconcile.
